target.statement: Training weighted CF (%) for P+R on CAMSL at K=5 (smallest dataset, smallest K), reported as 59.35% in Table II Panel B
target.table_ref: Table II, Panel B, CAMSL, K=5, CF column

compute.basis: No code released, so the full P+R pipeline (peak-time distribution K-means with 30 starts, constrained reassignment via rectangular assignment, refinement to convergence) must be reimplemented from the paper; CAMSL is the smallest panel (~4k customers, 30-min, ~9 months training) and the paper reports fitting times of seconds-to-minutes on a laptop-class CPU, so the dominant cost is data download/preprocessing plus writing and debugging the method.

blockers: No code or configs linked in the paper; method must be reimplemented from text
CAMSL data must be located/downloaded from Mendeley and preprocessed (cohort filtering, 30-min grid alignment)
Exact reproduction of the 59.35% value depends on matching 30 random K-means starts, tie-breaking in peak selection, and refinement tolerance
title: Coincidence-Maximizing Customer Clustering Using Smart Meter Data
